About Withso

Built around places.
Focused on people.

We build practical software for geospatial work, field operations and civic participation.

Chennai, India

A product company
with a geospatial core.

Withso develops its own software products, with Mapsmith and JurisField at the centre of our work. Our focus is simple: make spatial data easier to publish, understand and use in the real world.

We also build custom GIS applications for organisations. Our work connects product engineering with the practical needs of public systems and field teams.

Our product engineering is led by Santhosh Balaji S, whose experience spans software products and public-sector GIS systems.
